title: kate-core: accept any letter case in a modeline ending
summary: A modeline ending matches lf, crlf, and cr in either ASCII case. The lower values stay valid. The test goes in the existing modeline tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: modeline.rs is a private module of document.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Replace modeline_ending with one if else if chain. if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("unix") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("lf") { Some(LineEnding::Lf) } else if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("dos") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("crlf") { Some(LineEnding::CrLf) } else if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("mac") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("cr") { Some(LineEnding::Cr) } else { None }. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch ec_ending, set_modeline_rest, kate_bool, or modeline_overrides. The test a_modeline_accepts_upper_endings uses modeline_overrides. kate: eol LF; sets Some(LineEnding::Lf). kate: eol CRLF; sets Some(LineEnding::CrLf). kate: eol CR; sets Some(LineEnding::Cr). kate: eol lf; stays Some(LineEnding::Lf). kate: eol unix; stays Some(LineEnding::Lf). Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: document::modeline::tests::a_modeline_accepts_upper_endings
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. eol LF leaves the line ending unset. After the change LF is Lf, CRLF is CrLf, and CR is Cr. A lower lf stays Lf.
